title.es: En el curso 2024-2025, solo el 4,1 % de los alumnos de FP de grado básico y medio estudiaba en programas que combinan centro y empresa; en la UE, el 24,7 %
title.en: In the 2024-2025 school year, only 4.1% of basic and intermediate vocational students were in programmes combining school and workplace; in the EU, 24.7%

subtitle.es: Alumnos de FP de secundaria superior en programas combinados de centro y empresa, en % de los alumnos de FP de ese nivel. Cursos 2015-2016 a 2024-2025
subtitle.en: Upper-secondary vocational students in combined school- and work-based programmes, as % of vocational students at that level. School years 2015-2016 to 2024-2025

es: Programas combinados: los que reparten la formación entre el centro y la empresa, como la FP dual o el aprendizaje. Cada país decide qué programas clasifica así.
FP de secundaria superior: en España, sobre todo la FP de grado básico y de grado medio. La FP de grado superior no está incluida.
Eurostat fecha cada curso por el año en que empieza.
en: Combined programmes: those that split training between the school and the workplace, such as dual vocational training or apprenticeships. Each country decides which programmes it classifies this way.
Upper-secondary vocational training: in Spain, mainly basic and intermediate vocational training. Higher vocational training is not included.
Eurostat dates each school year by the year in which it starts.
